import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for the average transaction amount by transaction type, separated by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', estimator='mean', ci=None)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Average Transaction Amount by Transaction Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Amount ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
